page.layout: One page of text, with a woodcut ornament in the middle of the page, no marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number at top right. Below the text: signature "Gg" at left and catchword "IVLIA," at right.

main_text.p: Gerhardus dictus Magnus ejusque filius Henricus dictus Ferreus, hujusq; iterum filius Gerhardus primus in hac generosissima familia Slesvici Dux, cujus frater Henricus antistes fuit Osnabrugen-sis. Adolphus & Antonius fratres Jodoci filii Archipraesules Colonienses, Adolphus denique, qui uxorem Mariam Mestivoi Pomeraniae Ducis filiam, accepit.
Ex eadem familia prodiit Gerhardus quoque primus Dietmarsiae Dux, cujus filia Thodorico Oldenburgico nupta, regium Daniae stemma, per Duces Holsatiae propagavit.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament in the middle of the page is not text and is not transcribed. The running head is in spaced capitals. The catchword and signature are at the foot of the page.
